subject: Recap and MAP: Citrine Payments security requirements (SOC 2, retention, pen-test evidence)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Recap and MAP: Citrine Payments security requirements (SOC 2, retention, pen-test evidence)

Hi Julie — thanks again for the 45-minute call this morning. Quick summary and proposed mutual action plan (MAP) so we have alignment on scope, deliverables, and timing.

Key pain points you shared:
- Regulatory retention: need audit-log retention and exportability for up to 7 years for regulated merchant transaction trails.
- Evidence packages: procurement wants a digestible SOC 2 artifact set plus verifiable pen-test summaries (no raw findings).
- DPA & data residency: Citrine requires a DPA with explicit retention/erasure clauses and a US-region option for customer data.

Goals we heard:
1) Confirm Redwood can meet retention/export SLAs and provide a concise SOC 2 evidence bundle for procurement.
2) Deliver a clear DPA draft for legal review within two weeks.
3) Provide a sanitized pen-test summary and an evidence checklist for your security team to kick off their intake.

Proposed next steps / owner / ETA:
- Redwood to share: (A) SOC 2 evidence checklist (spreadsheet) + short guidance note, (B) DPA redline template, (C) redacted pen-test summary. Owner: Ava. ETA: 72 business hours for checklist and pen-test summary; 10 business days for DPA draft.
- Citrine to share: primary compliance contact and any specific template language they require (e.g., breach notification windows). Owner: Julie. ETA: reply in this thread with contact.
- Schedule a follow-up technical deep-dive with Citrine infra & Redwood security. Owner: Karthik to propose slots. ETA: propose by Mon 8/31.

Attachments in this message: SOC2-questions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet - draft of evidence we expect), DPA-draft-Citrine-v1.pdf (DPA skeleton), pen-test-summary-2025.pdf (sanitized).

If the above matches your expectations, I’ll upload the checklist to the shared Drive link and kick off the DPA draft with Legal.

Thanks — Ava

--

Subject: Re: Recap and MAP: Citrine Payments security requirements (SOC 2, retention, pen-test evidence)

Thanks Ava — that recap looks right. Quick notes from my side:
- Compliance lead: Matthew Ong (matthew.ong@citrinepay.com) will own the evidence intake; copying him on next steps after I confirm with Legal.
- For retention: our legal/ops ask for an exportable audit-log schema (JSON/CSV) and a retention policy that supports targeted deletion per customer. Can you confirm Redwood supports selective erasure and a log export API?
- Pen-test: we only need a high-level executive summary and confirmation that the vendor performed remediation verification; no raw PII should be exchanged.

I’ll confirm the preferred DPA language by Monday. Also, can you include a short note in the evidence checklist about what form of attestations (screenshots, log extracts, SOC auditor letter) you can provide?

Julie

Subject: Fwd: SOC2 evidence checklist draft + notes

Forwarding the first draft of the SOC2 evidence checklist I assembled after the call. Notes inline.

On Fri, Aug 28, 2026 at 10:15 AM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original recap)

Karthik's notes (high level):
- We can provide: SOC 2 auditor letter (redacted), control mappings (which controls we cover), sanitized log extracts (timeboxed, redacted), architecture diagrams (high level), and the pen-test executive summary. We cannot provide raw backups or PII-containing logs.
- Retention/export: Our audit-log export supports JSON/CSV for transaction/trace logs. Selective erasure at customer-request level is supported via our data management API; this is currently limited to account-level deletion, we should confirm whether Citrine needs object-level/row-level erasure.
- DPA: Legal will produce a DPA that includes retention windows, breach notification windows (72 hours), and a US-region data residency option.

Attachments: SOC2-questions_v1.xlsx (checklist).

I'll draft a short talk track for the technical deep-dive describing how KV cache and streaming logs can be exported without exposing customer PII.

-Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
